caption: The Lunima main window with a live CW simulation running on a staged mixed photonic/electric chip: a Mach-Zehnder interferometer (grating coupler in, 1x2 MMI splitter, electro-optic phase shifter arm, DBR-filter arm, 2x2 MMI combiner, photodetector and output coupler) whose waveguides show the simulated power flow as color plus dB/percent labels, DC probe pads and bond pads wired to the modulator and detector contacts as thick golden metal traces, diagonal (45°) autorouting and two hand-styled connections (SBend, Bend with custom radius) — all built from the bundled Demo and SiEPIC PDKs and routed by the production router.

The unified component editor in edit mode: fork-on-save banner, PDK and fabrication-process context, syntax-highlighted gdsfactory Python definition, a rendered geometry preview of the 1x2 MMI, and one-click S-matrix computation via Meep FDTD.

The PDK lifecycle in one view: the component library with per-component edit (fork-on-save) and restore-original quick actions on hover, the PDK Mgmt section listing a forked user copy that shadows its bundled original next to an own user library, and the trash panel restoring deleted PDKs or single components.
Eye/BER analysis: a PRBS-7-modulated transient folded into an eye-persistence heat map at 25 Gbps, with bit rate, PRBS pattern and decision-threshold controls plus CSV export.

Transient analysis: IFFT of the circuit S-parameters convolved with a Gaussian pulse source, plotting the time-domain power of several output pins (MZI bar/cross ports and the photodetector input) as separate toggleable traces.

Figma-style waveguide editing on the MZI's DBR arm: selecting a routed connection reveals draggable in-canvas bend-radius handles (screen-constant, with live radius labels) and the per-connection Routing panel, here switched to the Bend style with per-segment length/loss annotations.

The same main window live-switched between English and Japanese: every toolbar, panel and canvas HUD string re-reads instantly from the localization service — five languages ship (English, German, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Japanese).

The fabrication-process editor on a Cornerstone-like SiN 300 nm process: GDS layer stack, optical and metal routing cross-sections with per-cross-section minimum and recommended bend radii, and the process materials with user-supplied refractive indices.

The manufacturing story in one frame: the unified Export flyout over the staged chip (GDS via gdsfactory or Nazca, plus SAX, PhotonTorch, Verilog-A and YAML netlist), the PDK offset/calibration editor on the bundled SiEPIC EBeam PDK showing the grating coupler's rendered GDS geometry with its pin sitting exactly on the cell origin (1/1 aligned within 0.1 µm), and the Check-All calibration report with every checked SiEPIC cell green at Δ 0.00 µm.

Netlist export for the gdsfactory/SAX ecosystem: the right-panel Netlist section derives a YAML circuit netlist from the canvas — instances with settings (including the electrical probe/bond pads), informational placements, logical port-to-port connections with metal traces marked '# electrical', and exposed ports — ready to copy or save as .yml.
